highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed memory use across image pixels, font features, and stream decoding.
highlights_body: Image pixel copies and HarfBuzz feature-string decoding reduce temporary allocations, while front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily.

bullets.detail: Image pixel-copy operations reduce managed overhead when moving pixel data between SkiaSharp and application buffers.

bullets.lead: Font feature decoding avoids native allocations
bullets.detail: Feature-string decoding now avoids an unnecessary native allocation while preserving its existing results.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz text encoding buffers are reused
bullets.detail: UTF-32 encoding for HarfBuzz operations now reuses buffers to reduce temporary managed allocations.
Front-buffered stream handling no longer keeps buffered data alive after it is no longer needed.
